fix(deps): resolve vulnerable documentation dependencies (#214)

## Summary
- Resolve all 22 open Dependabot alerts in `uv.lock`: Filelock 3.32.5 →
4.2.7 (12), GitPython 3.1.62 → 3.2.1 (7), Tornado 6.5.9 → 6.6 (3).
- Upgrade mkdocs-rss-plugin 1.19.0 → 1.20.0 to remove its GitPython <3.2
constraint. Require Python >=3.11 for the **docs dependency group
only**, matching docs CI (Python 3.12); library/runtime support remains
Python >=3.10. This prevents vulnerable Python 3.10 docs-only fallback
resolutions.
- Also fix audit-only CVE-2026-115885 by moving langgraph-cli
0.4.32.dev0 → 0.4.32. No application code or runtime dependency
constraints changed.

## Test plan
- [x] `uv lock --check` and locked all-groups installation.
- [x] All-groups `pip-audit`: no known vulnerabilities on the local
Python 3.14 environment; before: 22 advisory matches across four
packages. Marker-specific inactive environments are not dynamically
audited.
- [x] Mechanically compare every resolved affected package version
against all 22 GitHub alert vulnerable ranges: none match, including all
lockfile alternatives.
- [x] `pytest tests/short_term -q`: 30 passed (one existing deprecation
warning).
- [x] `python -m mkdocs build --clean -f docs/mkdocs.yml --strict`:
passed (upstream notices/deprecations emitted).
- [x] `git diff --check`.

No alerts dismissed; GitHub alerts remain open until the fix is merged
and rescanned. Existing `.gitignore` lacks several secret-file patterns;
left unchanged to preserve remediation scope. Only `pyproject.toml` and
`uv.lock` are included.
